items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Paul put me in at NBC... I'd done a few things with Paul... he just walked in one day and said, why don't you do that slap thing with me in the vaudeville?

ctx.x: -- so when Paul went to the Coast, to do King of Jazz, he heard so much about her, see, and some of the guys in the Whiteman band had heard her sing and at a party --
